name: DOT Traffic Speeds
description:
This dataset contains traffic speed observations for road links in New York City, drawn from a DOT traffic monitoring feed. Each row represents a single reading for one road segment, identified by link_id and transcom_id, with a human-readable link_name and a borough label (Queens, Staten Island, Manhattan, Bronx, or Brooklyn). The owner field indicates which agency or authority manages the segment, such as NYC_DOT_LIC, MTA Bridges & Tunnels, or the Port Authority.

The core measurements are speed (in the units used by the source feed, ranging from 0 to about 75) and travel_time (0 to 4,151, likely seconds), along with a status code where 0 indicates a normal reading and -101 indicates missing or unavailable data. Each record carries a data_as_of timestamp, so readings can be tracked over time. Geographic information is provided as link_points (coordinate pairs) and encoded_poly_line with matching encoded_poly_line_l
